    fn into_expression(self, lhs: ast::Expression, rhs: ast::Expression) -> ast::Expression {
        use ast::Operator::*;
        match self {

            Self::LessThanOrEqual => Operator::LessThanOrEqual(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs)),
            Self::Like => Operator::Like(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs)),
            Self::Multiply => Operator::Multiply(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs)),
            Self::NotEqual => Operator::NotEqual(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs)),
            Self::Or => Operator::Or(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs)),
